The *Koladāyakattheraapadāna* is a short biographical verse text preserved in the *Therāpadāna* collection of the Pali Canon [SuttaCentral]. Belonging to the genre of elder apadānas, the poem recounts the past karmic deed of the elder Koladāyaka—conventionally signifying a donor of jujube fruit (*kola*)—and the resultant spiritual benefits and ultimate attainment. SuttaCentral records five modern translations of the text in five languages [SuttaCentral].
